title: Sauria Paharia people - Wikipedia
text: The Sauria Paharia people are a Dravidian ethnic people of Bangladesh and the Indian states of Jharkhand, West Bengal, and Bihar. They are found mostly in Santhal Parganas region in the Rajmahal Hills.

title: Sauria Paharia | Ethnologue Free
text: Sauria Paharia is a stable indigenous language of India and Bangladesh. It belongs to the Dravidian language family.

title: Sauria Paharia people
text: The Sauria Paharia speak the Sauria dialect of Malto, a Northern Dravidian language classified as a linguistic isolate amid predominantly Indo-Aryan and Austroasiatic speech communities in eastern India.

text: # Demographics Sauria Paharias are listed as a primitive tribe and have a population of around 45,000 in Jharkhand, with a possible negligible population in West Bengal. They constitute less than 1 per cent of the tribal population in Jharkhand.
